reply.headline: Typical rain, temperature, snow and wind for Porticello, Sicily, Italy on 19 Aug 2024.
why: Normal rain for the last 6 days (13.8 mm) was the check that set the level, with 11.3 mm in the 5 days before and the forecast for the day itself.

Days with this much rain over 6 days happen about 21 times a year here now, compared with about 24 times a year in 1951–1980, which does not make today any less serious because the level is based on the recent 30 years.
Normal wind for here (gusts up to 45 km/h) and normal highs for here (feels like up to 33 °C) also fit the recent record.
Days with feels-like heat like this are 2.0 times more common here than in 1951–1980.
reply.what_it_means: The checks for rain, heat, cold, snow and wind do not point to anything beyond what this place sees regularly, but they do not cover thunderstorms, freezing rain or ice on roads, or geological hazards such as landslides or glacier collapse. Thunderstorms are not checked, and storms are a major cause of weather deaths, so follow official storm warnings. Check your official weather warnings, because Groundtruth never replaces them.
